projects.title: HDCA
projects.alt: HDCA and other SMAP retrievals compared with in situ soil moisture at Millbrook, Massachusetts, and Tambopata.
projects.credit: Lee et al. (2027), Fig. 7 · Remote Sensing of Environment

summary.label: Problem
summary.text: Dense vegetation complicates soil moisture retrieval when vegetation scattering is assumed constant.

summary.label: Method
summary.text: HDCA jointly retrieves soil moisture, vegetation optical depth, and time-varying scattering albedo using a physical constraint.

summary.label: Finding
summary.text: Soil moisture bias was 0.008–0.025 m³/m³ at three evaluated temperate and Amazon forest sites.

projects.title: ASCAT2SMAP-V2
projects.alt: ASCAT2SMAP-V2 workflow linking ASCAT soil moisture, simulated brightness temperatures, and joint soil moisture and VOD retrieval.
projects.credit: Lee et al. (2026), Fig. 2 · IEEE JSTARS

summary.label: Problem
summary.text: Short satellite L-band records limit long-term monitoring of soil moisture and vegetation optical depth.

summary.label: Method
summary.text: ASCAT2SMAP-V2 translates ASCAT soil moisture, simulates L-band brightness temperatures, and retrieves soil moisture and vegetation optical depth.

summary.label: Finding
summary.text: Retrievals reproduce SMAP-like variability, while updated model parameters reduce soil moisture bias under vegetation.

projects.title: ASTRA
projects.alt: ASTRA workflow showing Swin-Unet translation and radiative transfer model inversion.

summary.label: Problem
summary.text: Vegetation attenuation and fixed retrieval parameters create systematic differences between AMSR2 and SMAP soil moisture.

summary.label: Method
summary.text: ASTRA uses Swin-Unet translation for SMAP-consistent estimates and radiative transfer inversion to interpret retrieved parameters.

summary.label: Finding
summary.text: Test-period agreement with SMAP reached R = 0.814 and ubRMSD = 0.027 m³/m³; in situ validation also improved over AMSR2.

projects.title: ESCAPE
projects.alt: ESCAPE autoencoder architecture with reconstruction and physics losses for soil moisture and surface roughness estimation.

summary.label: Problem
summary.text: Separating soil moisture, surface roughness, and vegetation effects from SAR observations creates an underconstrained retrieval problem.

summary.label: Method
summary.text: ESCAPE combines ten physics-informed autoencoders to retrieve soil moisture and roughness without in situ soil moisture training targets.

summary.label: Finding
summary.text: Spatial validation in Spain and Austria achieved R = 0.701 and ubRMSD = 0.089 m³/m³; ensembles improved retrieval robustness.

datasets.title: HDCA
datasets.description: Daily global 36 km retrievals from SMAP L-band observations, accounting for time-varying vegetation scattering. Includes soil moisture, vegetation optical depth, and effective scattering albedo for 2015–2025.

datasets.title: ASCAT2SMAP-V2
datasets.description: L-band-like soil moisture and vegetation optical depth derived from ASCAT observations, including A2S-DCA and A2S-NNP retrievals.
datasets.note: The reconstructed VOD represents a SMAP-like vegetation signal; it is not an independently validated long-term VOD record.

datasets.title: ASTRA
datasets.description: Daily 36 km soil moisture on the SMAP EASE-Grid 2.0 grid, covering July 2012–December 2023. Includes median scattering albedo and surface roughness layers.

datasets.title: SMAP-NN
datasets.description: Soil moisture and retrieved surface roughness and scattering albedo parameters from the neural-network-based SMAP retrieval study.
